structure_notice: Import selected page trees, applications, data models, MCP instances, and translations. Other target objects remain. Source business data is excluded.
plugin_notice: External data sources, MCP upstream credentials, and plugin packages are excluded. Add upstream credentials after import. Required plugins are verified and downloaded by the target system during installation.
preview_failed: Template preview failed. Clear this file and import it again.
shared_tool_impact: Shared tools in the selected MCP instance also affect these instances
install_unknown: The installation result could not be confirmed. Check the target resources before importing again.
partial_notice: Resources listed below may have been created or updated. They have not been rolled back. Resolve the reported failures before preparing another import.
selection_notice: Nothing is selected by default. Each selected page includes its descendants. Referenced definitions are included automatically.
access_denied: System backup and template permission is required.
catalog_preview_failed: Template preview failed. Close this preview and try again.
invalid_file: Could not read this template file. Choose a ZIP archive or a legacy JSON file.
merge_notice: Missing objects are created. Existing objects are updated only when unchanged since their last template baseline. Local changes and objects without a baseline are preserved and skipped; installation continues.
i18n_selection_notice: Select translation keys independently. All available locales for each selected key are included; keys are not inferred from page or application source code.
skip_missing_baseline: No template baseline is available; existing content is preserved.
skip_preserved: Existing content is preserved because it cannot be safely updated.
skipped_notice: Resources preserved and skipped: {{count}}. Other eligible resources were processed.
skip_user_deleted: This resource was deleted locally and will not be recreated.
skip_pending_write: A previous write has an unconfirmed outcome. This resource was skipped; check its state before retrying.
